title: Irreversible life-state conflict and evidence-backed reveal

finding.title: Isaac appears alive after his identified body is cremated
finding.summary: The draft objectively identifies and cremates Isaac's body before Isaac enters alive.
finding.question: Is Isaac's return after the confirmed cremation intentional?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: The lab identifies the body as Isaac and the hospital cremates it.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: Isaac later walks into the station alive.
finding.inference_explanation: No current evidence challenges the identification or cremation.

evidence.quote: The lab confirms the body is Isaac Vale. The body is cremated before dawn.
Isaac Vale walks into the station, alive and uninjured.
